item1.q: How do I join the server?
item1.a: Register on this site and submit the application form. Once approved, you can connect.

item2.q: Do I need a genuine copy of Minecraft?
item2.a: Yes. Only genuine Java Edition accounts can join; linking a Microsoft account verifies ownership when you sign in.

item3.q: Which version and server software do you run?
item3.a: Java Edition 1.21.x on Fabric. Only performance and bug-fix mods are loaded — no vanilla mechanics are changed.

item4.q: Is there an economy, a shop or any plugins?
item4.a: No. There is no economy, no shop and no plugins — gameplay is built entirely around vanilla redstone and building.

item5.q: Do I need mods to join?
item5.a: No, a vanilla client works. Performance mods are fine; anything that affects game balance is not.

rules.title: Server rules
rules.description: Please read these before applying. Following them together is what keeps the community stable.

behavior.title: General conduct
behavior.content: Be respectful to other players. No harassment, hate speech or discrimination.

gameplay.title: Game rules
gameplay.content: Cheating, hacked clients and bug exploitation are not allowed. Automation and redstone built from vanilla mechanics are.

building.title: Building rules
building.content: Do not damage other players' builds or occupy land they have already claimed, without permission.

punishment.title: Penalties
punishment.content: Breaking the rules may result in warnings, temporary bans or permanent bans depending on severity.

redstone.title: Redstone and machines
redstone.content: Machines and automation are welcome. Devices whose only purpose is to consume server performance — huge entity stacks, fast clocks used to lag the server — are not.
